templates.why_chosen: Star-rated: panels (a) and (b) draw the same GPE0-3 lanes as a Gantt timeline before and after rebalancing, letting shrunken idle gaps argue the fix, before panel (c) shows the scheduler hardware that produces it.
templates.what_to_learn: Draw the identical set of per-lane Gantt bars twice, once unbalanced and once rebalanced, so the reader compares idle-gap width directly instead of reading numbers; but keep labels at a readable size, since this figure's 2-3.5pt text is illegible without zooming.

templates.why_chosen: Before (a) and after (b) Gantt-style GPE timelines share an identical per-lane skeleton to show reduced idle gray time, while panel (c) mixes in the scheduler/workload-table/alpha-buffer hardware that implements the rebalancing.
templates.what_to_learn: Pair an identical-skeleton before/after timeline (same GPE lanes, same block width) with a separate hardware block-diagram panel that implements the fix, mixing a timeline kind with an architecture kind under one figure; keep font size well above this figure's illegible 2-3.5pt, a listed weakness.
